- **Fixed-rank sensitivity (G, post hoc, 20 of the 50 splits):** the headline k\* depends on the rank of the floor.
  - **k\* at 0.25 of the floor:** It is 3, 8 and 20 at fixed rank 4, 8 and 12, against 32 [20, 50] in the main run. The main run uses the inner-CV rank and a floor at the LOO-CV rank, which was 16 in fold 0.
